decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Individual narrow blades now curve smoothly outward from the dense tuft.

rear.note: Rear retains varied blade heights with continuous curves instead of angular stalks.

detail.note: Close view resolves tapered tips and folded blade centers without the old sharp elbow.

underside.note: The low angle retains distinct curved blades and the original bounded root footprint.

clay.note: Clay confirms curved modeled blades and varied spread throughout the tuft.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Seven rounded cloth folds hang between the original timber rails.

rear.note: Rear folds remain continuous with a restrained central sag.

detail.note: Close view shows smooth curvature across each fold and a gently bowed center line.

underside.note: The thin cloth meets the weighted lower rail without detached fold strips.

clay.note: Clay confirms continuous rounded folds with softened transitions and a thin closed edge.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Packed oval braided rows replace the previous stacked discs.

rear.note: Rear angle retains a low continuous textile outline on the original backing.

detail.note: Three-strand interlacing and the central terracotta band remain legible; spacing is now restrained.

underside.note: The connected dark backing remains closed beneath the braided surface.

clay.note: Clay confirms actual interlaced strand relief across the oval surface.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Smooth flared pedestal now flows continuously from the disc foot into the round top.

rear.note: Rear repeats the slender curved waist without contour bands.

detail.note: Close view confirms a smooth foot transition and rounded circular tabletop rim.

underside.note: Upper stem flares into the underside of the tabletop without the former gap.

clay.note: Clay confirms a continuous tulip profile with a flat top and grounded foot.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Connected upper side rails now enclose the fitted blue bedding.

rear.note: Rear rails join the tall corner posts and the head end.

detail.note: Two rail levels sit above the upper mattress while preserving the ladder-end opening.

underside.note: Original ladder and lower frame remain attached beneath the new guard construction.

clay.note: Clay confirms bounded side and head rails connected to the existing posts.
